note: Descriptions of the source interactive sections (loaders, cards, carousels). Inspiration for motion patterns; no code.

sections.title: Cards Almanac
sections.description: A quiet column of dispatch cards that pin and pile as you scroll, each one settling flat over the last.

sections.title: Cards Cascade
sections.description: A deck of art cards that fans flat at the back, rises to a single upright crest, then folds forward and cascades into a pit.

sections.title: Carousel Spotlight
sections.description: A concave ring of gallery cards curving through a bright editorial stage, snapping to whichever work faces you.

sections.title: Carousel Under The Radar
sections.description: A wide crown of ink-in-water cards fanning across the top of the frame, spun by hand between oversized editorial type.

sections.title: Colonnade
sections.description: A row of chapter columns on warm paper, each sliding its panel upward as you move between them in one continuous conveyor.

sections.title: Mirror Hall Hero
sections.description: A full-bleed hero where the headline stands on a reflective floor, the world below it rippling as you move.

sections.title: Altitude Loader — Aperture Count
sections.description: A full-screen ground with comets drifting down-left behind a thin progress ring and a counting figure. The count springs to 90 on trust, waits for the page, then snaps to 100 — and at 100 the ground opens like an aperture: a soft-edged hole grows from the centre past the corners while the page underneath is already animating in through it.
vibes: counting up to something worth waiting for
a shutter easing wide rather than a curtain snapping

sections.title: Artist Loader — Corner Counter, Wipe Up
sections.description: A gallery-quiet gate in the page's own ground: a small-caps studio label pinned bottom-left, an oversized percentage bottom-right counting itself up, then the whole plate slides off the top edge while the page beneath is already moving.
vibes: a page turning, not a spinner
the lights coming up in a white room

sections.title: Baseline Loader
sections.description: A flat accent curtain that holds the page, draws a hairline progress bar left to right, then slides straight up off the top edge while the content underneath plays its words in behind it.

sections.title: Flowstate Loader
sections.description: No curtain and no counter — the generative field detonates on the first frame and the page assembles itself out of the afterglow on one 2.4-second stagger.
vibes: the page arrives out of the glow

sections.title: Forma Percentage Curtain
sections.description: A quiet full-screen curtain that counts honestly to 100, collapses its card-height progress slab to the right, and hands the page one spring cascade on the way out.

sections.title: Gravity Loader
sections.description: A wordmark masks up glyph-by-glyph over a hairline bar that refuses to finish until the 3D scene has actually rendered — then the gate lifts and the page rises in one measured stagger.
vibes: a studio calibrating before it speaks

sections.title: Halcyon Loader — Wordmark Out Of Blur
sections.description: A dark entry veil holding a single display wordmark that surfaces letter by letter out of deep blur, then dissolves — blurring out and swelling past the viewer — to hand the frame to the scene waiting behind it.
vibes: the title card of a film

sections.title: Loopstack Loader
sections.description: A wordmark sweeps in glyph by glyph from the left along the bottom edge, each letter climbing out of its own mask from behind a 20px blur; the last one lands at 1.92s and the page above it rises word by word out of the same kind of mask.

sections.title: Lumora Intro Counter
sections.description: An inverted full-screen slab that holds the page shut while a hairline meter fills and a three-digit counter climbs, then springs up off the top edge and hands the first screen its entrance.

sections.title: Percent Curtain Loader
sections.description: A near-empty dark field with a wordmark in one corner and a huge percent counter in the other; at 100 the labels blink out and the whole plate slides up like a curtain, releasing the page underneath.

sections.title: Mirror Hall
sections.description: A rotunda of glowing cards standing on a near-black reflective pool, their light spilling and rippling across the water as you spin the ring.

sections.title: Roadmap Ascent
sections.description: A dark scroll-pinned growth story where a fixed node holds the centre and the timeline climbs through it toward a rising count.

sections.title: Showcase Equator
sections.description: A split purple-and-beige stage where a shuffling deck of reel-cards and a gliding category list move as one.

sections.title: Slider Slipstream
sections.description: A river of portrait cards riding one tilted belt that recedes into black, looming near on the right and dissolving far on the left.

sections.title: Slider Spectra
sections.description: A coverflow fan of eyewear cards on a near-black stage, the centre card standing bright and casting a halo keyed to its own hue.
